unresolved: The exponent-separator option is set to ".", which is also the decimal-separator. XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.1 forbids that: "For any named or unnamed decimal format, the properties representing characters used in a picture string must have distinct values. These properties are decimal-separator, grouping-separator, exponent-separator, percent, per-mille, digit, and pattern-separator." No authority says what a JSONata engine should do with a decimal format that breaks the rule, so this expectation is a regression pin over jsntrs' current behaviour, not a derived answer — see README.md and jsntrs-qr9.
